title: Vision of a rocket exploding at launch

tellings.quote: one time I I saw um a missile um uh being launched

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that once, between 1990 and 1993, while at a site he calls Base C-van, he saw in a vision a missile being launched and exploding, possibly a Chinese launch. He tells it on the show as something he experienced himself, and it is connected to the book Above Black; if true, it would mean he was shown distant events he could not otherwise have seen.
